maintenance_led.reason: Sells plasma-derived immune globulins (ASCENIV, BIVIGAM, Nabi-HB) as therapies for patients, not repair, servicing or replacement of installed equipment.

publicly_funded.reason: Immune globulin sales (ASCENIV, BIVIGAM) are paid mostly by commercial insurers and private payers, with some government share.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows by commercializing its own FDA-approved immune globulin products and plasma centers, not through regular acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: FDA-licensed immune globulins for immune-compromised patients; switching therapies carries clinical risk and needs physician and payer involvement.

notes: Payer mix is not stated on the website; publicly_funded relies on general knowledge that private payers dominate.
